- Line to (29.76,26.19)

(10.59,70.87) → (29.76,26.19) → (73.72,11.48) → (88.18,72.63) → (42.74,97.90) → back to (10.59,70.87).  

So the shape has **6 vertices** and **6 sides** → that’s a hexagon.
